text: {"label":"Video Modeling and Video Feedback","definition":"Using recorded video models, video prompts, voiceover instruction, and video feedback to teach daily living, employment, sport, and medical skills to learners, and to train staff, supervisors, teachers, and caregivers.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Defined by video as the teaching medium, unlike general skill-acquisition arrangements, conversation and communication training, or behavioral skills training packages delivered without a video focus."}
